selectionMethod: The set was frozen before any Witness detector output was inspected.

Take the five most recently merged PRs before the cutoff from averray-agent/agent and depre-dev/averray-reference-agent, plus the six most recent from the lower-volume private agent-harness repository.

Add two predeclared stress strata to each Node repository: a real CI/config change and a small or test-only change. This yields exactly 20 PRs across documentation, tests, refactors, features, configuration, and CI.
No selected PR was removed for looking likely to trigger a detector.
